purpose: Select the Jev cascade certainty threshold before confirmatory execution.

sample_design.labels: Ground-truth decision labels are frozen before provider inference for each calibration item.

selection_rule.candidate_thresholds: Unique observed effective-certainty values in descending precision, plus 1.0 and 0.0 boundaries.
selection_rule.error_bound: Wilson upper confidence bound on accepted incorrect decisions must be <= 0.05.
selection_rule.objective: Among feasible thresholds, choose the lowest threshold (maximum coverage).
selection_rule.no_feasible_threshold: NO_THRESHOLD; Arm C cannot proceed to confirmatory execution.
